metadata.title: Docetaxel, Carboplatin and Trastuzumab (TCH) – 21 days
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

audited_eligibility: baseline_lvef: >55%; clinical judgment if 50–55% (trial footnote includes >=50%)

source_monitoring.echo_baseline: LVEF assessment before starting HER2-directed treatment; see specific source wording.
source_monitoring.echo_ongoing: ECHO/MUGA every 12 weeks and at completion; consider every 4–8 weeks if cardiac impairment.
source_monitoring.timing_caveat: Cycle 1 is baseline. Later cycle landmarks assume uninterrupted 21-day cycles; elapsed 12-week intervals govern after delays.
source_monitoring.disease_imaging: Individual treatment plan and consultant direction; no universal fixed CT interval in these regimen PDFs.
source_monitoring.other_pathways: DEXA may be indicated by a separate endocrine/ovarian-suppression pathway, not automatically by this HER2 regimen.
source_monitoring.bloods_baseline: FBC, liver and renal profile; measured GFR preferred or GFR/CrCl estimate.
source_monitoring.bloods_regular: FBC, renal and liver profile; day-1 count-based dosing. The regular-tests bullet does not state an explicit cycle interval.
source_monitoring.creatinine_recency: If estimating GFR, creatinine within 48 hours before administration. If isotope GFR, reassess if creatinine rises above 110% of reference.
source_monitoring.echo_source_discrepancy: Baseline tests say if clinically indicated, although eligibility requires a baseline LVEF. Use trastuzumab SmPC if strengthening baseline wording.

schedule_alternatives: Default: IV trastuzumab 8→6 mg/kg every 21 days.
Weekly IV alternative: 4→2 mg/kg weekly with q21 chemotherapy; switch to q21 after source-defined transition.
SC alternative: 600 mg every 21 days, no loading; six combination cycles then trastuzumab to one year total.
metadata.schedule_summary: Default: six 21-day TCH cycles with IV trastuzumab, then trastuzumab alone to complete one year total. The source also permits weekly IV or fixed-dose SC trastuzumab alternatives; the team confirms the formulation and visit schedule.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the official regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.
